answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can grow reputation like a trellis: every new identity starts at the bottom and earns each rung only by completing work that independent peers verify and stake on. An attacker cannot sprint to the summit, because each level demands fresh, costly, checkable contributions rather than self-issued claims, and the onyx ledger records every rung permanently, so a fake identity that burns its stake is exposed and cannot quietly replant itself elsewhere.
